          "text": "# Albireo B: The Blue Spark at the Swan\u2019s Beak\n\n*On summer nights, a small telescope turns one bright star into a color contrast\u2014and reveals a hot, emission-line star hiding in plain sight.*\n\nAt the beak of Cygnus, the Swan, Albireo looks like a single point to the unaided eye.
